interface.name: aqueous_capture_color_manager_v1

description.summary: color information for individual captured frames

interface.description: This Aqueous extension describes the pixels delivered by an ext_image_copy_capture_frame_v1. It does not grant capture access or modify the standard capture protocol. Color information is associated with the actual copied buffer, not the output state at request time.

entry.name: invalid_frame
entry.summary: frame is inert or capture has started

entry.name: duplicate
entry.summary: frame already has a color info object

request.name: get_frame_info

description.summary: describe the pixels of a pending frame

request.description: Call before the frame's capture request. At most one live info object may be associated with a frame. Destroying the manager does not affect its info objects. A successful frame receives a complete description or unavailable before its ready event. Failed or destroyed frames may receive unavailable; no description is usable unless the frame succeeds.

interface.name: aqueous_capture_color_info_v1

description.summary: immutable description of delivered capture pixels

interface.description: A description consists of encoding, optional mastering_display and content_light events, then done. Alternatively, unavailable is sent. Exactly one of done or unavailable is sent unless this object is destroyed. Events describe destination pixels: an SDR conversion has SDR metadata, while native SHM capture retains its source encoding. Information remains valid after the frame is destroyed. Destroy this object when done with it. This version does not guarantee metadata for DMA-BUF, scene or cursor sources; clients must handle unavailable and must not infer HDR from buffer bit depth. All luminances use 0.0001 cd/m² units.

event.name: encoding
event.description: reference_white is the nominal reference luminance of the transfer function (203 cd/m² for PQ, 80 for SDR). sdr_white is the diffuse white used to place SDR content in the source HDR image, or 80 for SDR output. Neither value is a peak luminance. They are distinct from optional mastering metadata. SDR fallback pixels are gamma22 with sRGB primaries.

event.name: mastering_display
event.description: Chromaticities are CIE 1931 xy values in millionths. This event is omitted when the source has no usable mastering primaries/luminances.

event.name: content_light
event.description: A zero value indicates that the corresponding value is unspecified. This event is omitted if both values are unspecified.
